title: Roll back invalid batches and replay requests safely
preconditions: A writable Saga fixture and an idempotency request ID are available.

steps.action: Submit a batch containing valid entries and one invalid entry.
steps.expected_result: The complete batch is rejected and none of its records are written.

steps.action: Submit a valid mutation with a new request ID.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one record graph is written.

steps.action: Repeat the identical request ID and then reuse it with a different payload.
steps.expected_result: The identical request replays without duplicates and the conflicting payload is rejected.

expected_result: Pass when invalid batches leave zero partial writes and request replay is deterministic; fail on a partial write, duplicate record, or accepted payload conflict.
